Why were older types of economizers constructed invariably of cast iron?
options: Because cast iron resists corrosion better than mild steel and the pressures were comparatively low.
Because cast iron is more abundant than any other type of steel.
Because its thermal conductivity is very small and it gives greater efficiency to the system.
questions.answer: Because cast iron resists corrosion better than mild steel and the pressures were comparatively low.
